kdd99.description: KDD Cup 1999 full training set, kddcup.data.gz (4,898,431 rows)
kdd99.source: Original UCI file as mirrored on figshare by scikit-learn (sklearn.datasets.fetch_kddcup99). The UCI host now answers 403 for the data files.
kdd99.provenance: SHA-256 pinned independently by scikit-learn (_kddcup99.py) and TensorFlow Datasets (datasets/kddcup99/checksums.tsv, for http://kdd.ics.uci.edu/databases/kddcup99/kddcup.data.gz, 18,115,902 bytes): byte-identical to the original.
kdd99.citation: Stolfo et al., KDD Cup 1999 Data, UCI Machine Learning Repository, https://doi.org/10.24432/C51C7N

kdd99_test.description: KDD Cup 1999 labelled test set ('corrected', 311,029 rows), as parquet
kdd99_test.source: Hugging Face akahana/kdd-cup-1999 at commit 44542fc. No byte-identical public copy of corrected.gz was reachable (UCI 403; IEEE DataPort needs a login).
kdd99_test.provenance: Not byte-verifiable against TFDS's corrected.gz hash (abd81655..., 1,409,035 bytes) because it was converted to parquet. Checked by content instead: the same upload's training split (kdd99_hf_train) must equal the verified kdd99 file row for row (scripts/check_sources.py).
kdd99_test.citation: Stolfo et al., KDD Cup 1999 Data

kdd99_hf_train.description: Training split of the same Hugging Face upload; used only to validate the conversion

nslkdd.description: NSL-KDD (KDDTrain+, KDDTest+): KDD99 with duplicates removed
nslkdd.source: Original NSL-KDD zip, GitHub mirror Jehuty4949/NSL_KDD (formerly defcom17/NSL_KDD) pinned at commit 27bbbdf (2015-07-30). The official CIC download sits behind a registration form. Integrity is checked independently in E0b: every NSL-KDD row must occur in the official UCI KDD99 files.
nslkdd.licence: Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity terms; cite Tavallaee et al. 2009
nslkdd.citation: Tavallaee, Bagheri, Lu, Ghorbani. A Detailed Analysis of the KDD CUP 99 Data Set. IEEE CISDA 2009

unsw_nb15.description: UNSW-NB15 official partition: UNSW_NB15_training-set.csv (175,341) and UNSW_NB15_testing-set.csv (82,332)
unsw_nb15.source: Hugging Face Mireu-Lab/UNSW-NB15 @ 3eb02c4 (test.csv / train.csv). The official files sit in a UNSW SharePoint folder that cannot be fetched by script.
unsw_nb15.provenance: Mireu-Lab's test.csv is byte-identical (same SHA-256) to Mouwiya/UNSW-NB15 @ 8ad6b19's UNSW_NB15_training-set.csv, an independent upload under the official name: Mireu-Lab swapped the names. Stored here under the official names. Row and per-category counts are checked against the official page (totals) and Moustafa & Slay 2016 as reproduced in secondary tables (per category).
unsw_nb15.licence: UNSW-NB15 terms (free for academic research; cite Moustafa & Slay 2015, 2016)
unsw_nb15.citation: Moustafa & Slay, UNSW-NB15: a comprehensive data set for network intrusion detection systems, MilCIS 2015

cicids2017.description: CIC-IDS2017 MachineLearningCSV.zip: 8 per-day CSVs, 2,830,743 flows, 78 features + Label
cicids2017.source: Hugging Face bencorn/CICIDS2017 @ 811c007, csvs/MachineLearningCSV.zip (the official CIC download sits behind a registration form; no official checksum is published)
cicids2017.provenance: The 8 CSVs inside the zip must be byte-identical to the 8 CSVs uploaded independently in c01dsnap/CIC-IDS2017 @ 4e9edfa (hashes in experiments/check_week4.py), and label counts must equal Table II of Ahmim et al. 2018 (arXiv:1812.09059).
cicids2017.licence: Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity terms; cite Sharafaldin et al. 2018
cicids2017.citation: Sharafaldin, Lashkari, Ghorbani. Toward Generating a New Intrusion Detection Dataset and Intrusion Traffic Characterization. ICISSP 2018

ember2018.description: EMBER 2018 (feature version 2): raw PE features as JSON lines, 800k train (incl. 200k unlabelled) + 200k test, temporal split
ember2018.provenance: SHA-256 published in the elastic/ember README
ember2018.licence: Data: MIT (EMBER code is AGPL-3.0 and is not used or copied here)
ember2018.citation: Anderson & Roth. EMBER: An Open Dataset for Training Static PE Malware Machine Learning Models. arXiv:1804.04637

uci_phishing.description: UCI Phishing Websites: 11,055 sites, 30 ternary features, Result label
uci_phishing.provenance: Official source; SHA-256 recorded on first download. Row and class counts checked against the UCI page / paper.
uci_phishing.citation: Mohammad, Thabtah, McCluskey. Phishing Websites Features. UCI ML Repository, https://doi.org/10.24432/C51W2X

phiusiil.description: PhiUSIIL Phishing URL dataset: 235,795 URLs with 54 features, URL text
phiusiil.provenance: Official source; SHA-256 recorded on first download. Row and class counts checked against the UCI page / paper.
phiusiil.citation: Prasad & Chandra. PhiUSIIL: A diverse security profile empowered phishing URL detection framework based on similarity index and incremental learning. Computers & Security 2024

sms_spam.provenance: Official source; SHA-256 recorded on first download. Row and class counts checked against the UCI page / paper.
sms_spam.citation: Almeida, Gómez Hidalgo, Yamakami. Contributions to the Study of SMS Spam Filtering. DocEng 2011

unsw_raw_official.description: UNSW-NB15 raw records: UNSW-NB15_1..4.csv (2,540,047 lines = 2,540,044 records + 3 boundary repeats), the feature list and the event list
unsw_raw_official.source: The authors' public OneDrive share linked from https://research.unsw.edu.au/projects/unsw-nb15-dataset (folder CSV Files); downloaded 2026-10-16 with resumed transfers, sizes equal the share's listing
unsw_raw_official.provenance: Validated (experiments/unsw_raw.provenance): 2,540,044 records and 49 columns as in 'The UNSW-NB15 description.pdf'; Normal 2,218,761 and the nine families Generic 215,481, Exploits 44,525, Fuzzers 24,246, DoS 16,353, Reconnaissance 13,987, Analysis 2,677, Backdoor 2,329, Shellcode 1,511, Worms 174; labels agree with categories. Each file ends with the record the next begins with; the loader drops those 3 repeats.
unsw_raw_official.citation: N. Moustafa and J. Slay, UNSW-NB15: a comprehensive data set for network intrusion detection systems, MilCIS 2015
unsw_raw_official.licence: UNSW-NB15 terms (research use, cite the authors); not redistributed here
